prompt: Who was older, the guitar player for the Dugites from 1982-1983 or the lead singer of The Sports?
answer: Stephen Cummings was older. The Dugites’ guitarist, Andrew Pendlebury, was born around 1957, while The Sports’ lead singer, Stephen Cummings, was born on September 13, 1954—making Cummings roughly three years older.
